findings.finding: Prominent shark jawbone arch behind the landlord is not specified in the storyboard and can distract from the primary action.
findings.visible_evidence: A large semicircular jaw with many pointed teeth frames the landlord behind the bar, spanning from counter to ceiling.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the oversized shark jawbone behind the bar. Replace with understated shelves and a cracked-glass curios case as background dressing. Keep the two-shot focus on Ishmael and the landlord and preserve clear bottom-center negative space for the caption.

findings.finding: Peter Coffin lacks the specified tied-back hair or cap.
findings.visible_evidence: In the left background, the landlord planing wood has a bare, balding head with no cap or tied-back hair.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a simple cap or tie the landlord’s hair back in a short queue while keeping his waistcoat and rolled-up sleeves; retain his planing pose and background placement.

findings.finding: Optional supporting visual of a central iron stove is absent.
findings.visible_evidence: The room shows the bench, window, door, candle, and workbench, but no iron stove is visible.
findings.repair_prompt: Introduce a small central iron stove in the midground without blocking Ishmael or crowding the top-right caption area.

findings.finding: Bottom-left caption zone is partially occupied by Ishmael’s coat and trousers, reducing clean negative space for lettering.
findings.visible_evidence: The lower-left corner shows Ishmael’s dark clothing and his extended arm intruding toward that area; only a narrow sliver of blank wall remains.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose slightly to clear the bottom-left: nudge Ishmael and his pointing arm a bit right, or expand the blank wall margin on the lower-left; keep lighting and poses, preserve tight two-shot.

findings.finding: The ‘stick shaving on the landlord’s fingers’ is not clearly visible on his fingers; most shavings are on the tabletop.
findings.visible_evidence: Small wood curls lie on the table near the candle, while the landlord’s fingers appear mostly clean.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a thin, curling wood shaving draped over or pinched between the landlord’s fingers to emphasize mid-whittle detail.

findings.finding: Papered fireboard, listed as a visible prop, is not shown.
findings.visible_evidence: Room walls are bare except for a door at right and gear at left; no fireplace opening or papered panel is visible anywhere in the frame.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a simple fireplace on one wall closed by a thin papered fireboard with non-readable patterned paper; keep it subdued and in background, maintain clean top-center caption space, and avoid any readable imagery or text.

findings.finding: Harpoon is displayed across the fireplace mantel instead of standing by the bed as a background prop.
findings.visible_evidence: A long iron harpoon lies horizontally on the mantel above the hearth and candle.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the harpoon from the mantel; if included at all, place a tall iron harpoon upright at the bed’s head as a background element, or omit it for this frame.

findings.finding: Tomahawk-pipe and seal-skin wallet on a sea chest are missing despite being specified supporting visuals.
findings.visible_evidence: No tomahawk-shaped pipe, wallet, or sea chest is visible near the bed or hearth; only a chair with the grego and a seaman’s bag are present.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a sea chest near the bed with a tomahawk-shaped pipe and a small seal-skin wallet resting on it; keep them unobtrusive.

findings.finding: Papered fireboard set aside is not shown.
findings.visible_evidence: Open hearth with andirons and a small blaze, but no thin papered fireboard panel propped nearby.
findings.repair_prompt: Include a thin, printed-paper-covered fireboard panel leaned to one side of the fireplace with no readable imagery.

findings.finding: Biscuit used to tend the small blaze is not visible.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg kneels and reaches toward the fire, but no biscuit is shown in hand or within reach.
findings.repair_prompt: Depict a small hard biscuit in Queequeg’s hand or set at the hearth’s edge as he tends the shavings.

findings.finding: Extra set-dressing not in contract (wooden chest with coiled rope and glass bottles) may confuse prop continuity around the seaman’s bag.
findings.visible_evidence: Lower-left foreground shows a wooden chest with thick rope draped over it; two bottles sit on the left dresser.
findings.repair_prompt: Remove the wooden chest and bottles, or push them into deep shadow. If a luggage prop is desired, replace with a soft-sided, weathered canvas sea-bag cinched with rope.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s skin tone does not show the described purplish-yellow cast.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg is rendered with a medium brown tone under warm light without the specified purplish-yellow hue.
findings.repair_prompt: Grade Queequeg’s skin toward a subtle purplish-yellow cast while keeping his dark square tattoo patterns distinct.

findings.finding: Specified ash flecks from the pipe are not visible on the blanket.
findings.visible_evidence: Despite smoke from the tomahawk-pipe, the blanket surface near the bowl appears clean with no specks.
findings.repair_prompt: Add a few tiny, nonsparking ash flecks on the blanket beneath the pipe bowl; keep them subtle so they don’t draw focus.
